title.narrative: State and Resilience Building Contract for Kosovo

description.narrative: Contract related to: State and Resilience Building Contract for Kosovo - The overall objective of this Action is to assist Kosovo through targeted growth-enhancing policy measures aimed at mitigating the socio-economic impact of the rising gas prices and of the energy crisis in particular on small and medium sized enterprises and households, and to strengthen the Administration¿s overall capacity to deliver tailor-made services to vulnerable households and support the long-term socioeconomic recovery, energy security, and energy transition of Kosovo. The action will contribute to an increased access to reliable, energy and resources efficient affordable housing and commercial facilities.
